body.id: Bertanya jalan: 请问，银行怎么走？ Qǐngwèn, yínháng zěnme zǒu? = Permisi, ke bank lewat mana?
body.en: Asking the way: 请问，银行怎么走？ Qǐngwèn, yínháng zěnme zǒu? = Excuse me, how do I get to the bank?

body.id: 一直走 yīzhí zǒu = lurus, 往左拐 wǎng zuǒ guǎi = belok kiri, 往右拐 wǎng yòu guǎi = belok kanan.
body.en: 一直走 yīzhí zǒu = straight on, 往左拐 wǎng zuǒ guǎi = turn left, 往右拐 wǎng yòu guǎi = turn right.

body.id: 了 le sesudah kata kerja = sudah terjadi: 我买了两张票。 Wǒ mǎi le liǎng zhāng piào.
body.en: 了 le after a verb = it's done: 我买了两张票。 Wǒ mǎi le liǎng zhāng piào.

body.id: 今天天气怎么样？ Jīntiān tiānqì zěnmeyàng? — 很热，三十二度。 Hěn rè, sānshí'èr dù.

body.id: 了 le di akhir = keadaan baru: 下雨了！ Xià yǔ le! 会 huì = akan: 明天会下雨。 Míngtiān huì xià yǔ.
body.en: 了 le at the end = a new situation: 下雨了！ Xià yǔ le! 会 huì = will: 明天会下雨。 Míngtiān huì xià yǔ.

body.id: Tiongkok punya empat musim; Indonesia dua: 雨季 yǔjì dan 旱季 hànjì.

model_answer.en: Ancient China split the year into 24 periods by the sun's yearly path: 二十四节气 èrshísì jiéqì, from 立春 lìchūn 'Beginning of Spring' to 大寒 dàhán 'Greater Cold'. UNESCO listed them in 2016.

items.source: UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage, "The Twenty-Four Solar Terms, knowledge in China of time and practices developed through observation of the sun's annual motion" (inscribed in 2016, 11.COM; the sun's annual motion divided into 24 segments, from the Beginning of Spring to the Greater Cold; still a guide for farmers), ich.unesco.org/en/RL/the-twenty-four-solar-terms-knowledge-in-china-of-time-and-practices-developed-through-observation-of-the-sun-s-annual-motion-00647.
